item.title: CSSZ vs. Czech & Slovak Union – Football Match ⚽🍺
item.description:
It’s match time! ⚽ CSSZ – Czech and Slovak Students in Zurich vs. Czech & Slovak Union (Instagram) in a friendly football match at the Allmend in Zurich.

Date & Time

Thursday, October 22, 2026 at 17:00

Location

Allmend II & III – the football pitches right next to the Züri Fit calisthenics / street workout park, just behind the Saalsporthalle and across from Sihlcity.

What to Expect

  • ⚽ Friendly match – CSSZ vs. Czech & Slovak Union
  • 👟 All levels welcome, and women are very welcome to play!
  • 🍺 Beer, drinks and snacks included
  • 👀 Spectators welcome! Not playing? Come watch, cheer and enjoy a beer with us
  • 🎉 Good company and a chance to meet the other Czech & Slovak community in Zurich

Getting There

From Zürich HB:

  • 🚆 S4 (from the underground SZU platforms) to Zürich Saalsporthalle-Sihlcity – only about 5 minutes
  • 🚋 or Tram 13 to Saalsporthalle

From the stop, walk past the Saalsporthalle onto the Allmend – the pitches are next to the outdoor workout park, just a few minutes on foot.

What to Bring

  • ✅ Sports clothes
  • ✅ Football boots or sports shoes
  • ✅ Shin guards (if you have them)
  • ✅ Water bottle
  • ✅ Warm layer for after the match (October evenings get chilly!)
  • ✅ Team spirit! 💪

Registration

Please register here if you’d like to play, so we know how many people to expect and how much beer and snacks to bring! 🍻

See you on the pitch! 😊

item.title: Evening at the Baden Thermal Baths ♨️🍷
item.description:
It’s that time of year again! ♨️ This Saturday we’re heading to the outdoor thermal baths in Baden for an evening of pure relaxation in 45°C water.

Date & Time

Saturday, October 17, 2026 at 19:00

What to Expect

  • 🆓 Free entry - the baths are open to the public at no cost
  • 🍷 Wine, beer and snacks will be provided
  • ♨️ Hot thermal water (~45°C) under the evening sky

Getting There

Take an SBB train from Zürich HB to Baden station. From there it’s just a short walk to the Heisse Brunnen. 🚆

What to Bring

  • ✅ Swimsuit
  • ✅ Towel
  • ✅ Warm clothes for afterwards (October evenings get chilly!)
  • ✅ Flip-flops or sandals
  • ✅ Good mood and a will to relax! 🎉

Registration

Entry is free, but please register here so we know how much wine, beer and snacks to bring! 🍻

If you have the time and the mood, see you there in the evening. 😊

item.title: General Assembly
item.description:
Dear CSSZ members,

On September 29th we will host a General Assembly (GA). We will look back at our activities of the last year, discuss the direction the society should take and elect a new board. In addition, we will vote on the new version of the statutes.

  1. Summary of last academic year
  2. Election of CSSZ Board
  3. Vote on the new statutes
  4. If you have a proposal you would like to discuss, please submit it here: https://forms.gle/yfUGbZiRoNVJGkQU7

The Board of Czech and Slovak Students in Zurich

item.title: Semester Welcome Event (Autumn 2026)
item.description: Join us for a lively kick-off to the Autumn semester 2026 at the bQm bar 🍻, where the Czech and Slovak Students in Zurich will meet up for a beer ⭐. This is a great opportunity for both new and existing students to meet 🤝. We look forward to seeing you there! 🎉
